title: Eval Quality Safeguard: Console notification orchestration and regression wiring
creator: Aisha Mehta
description: Goal: Surface eval-driven quality regressions in the Redwood Console and integrate notifications into team workflows (Slack + PagerDuty) with deterministic deduplication and quick remediation actions. We want to reduce noisy alerts while ensuring high-severity regressions (per-customer or per-model SLO violations) get immediate attention and clear context for triage. This ticket scopes the product requirements, routing matrix, dedupe fingerprint, and Console UI hooks for in-channel remediation actions (ack, mute, start canary, rollback request).
acceptance_criteria: Console shows a new 'Eval Change' card on model pages listing recent regression signals with baseline_delta, regression_score, and sample failures
Alerts for the same underlying change (model_version diff + config delta) are deduped within a configurable window (default 30m) and surfaced as a single Slack thread + PD incident
PagerDuty routing follows policy matrix: production models -> PD escalation policy A; staging models -> Slack only; dedicated-customer with SLA -> PD + analytics channel

Slack message includes: 1) short summary, 2) affected model and environment, 3) top 3 failing prompt samples with diffs, 4) links to eval run and model diff, and 5) two quick actions (Open rollback PR template, Create canary rollout).
MTTD (mean time to detect) for eval regressions is instrumented and reported in Console telemetry (goal < 15m), and false positive rate tracked via triage labels (< 10% target).
Playbook link and suggested remediation steps are included in each alert for product/engineers to follow.
technical_notes: Signal fingerprinting: compute stable key = hash(model_family + model_version_diff_signature + config_patch_id + eval_suite_id). Alert instances with same key within dedupe_window should collapse into existing thread/incident.
Backend: Add eval_change table with minimal snapshot (baseline_metrics, new_metrics, top_samples, change_signature). Expose via API for Console and alerting service.
Routing: extend existing alert router to read model tags (env, customer_sla, capacity_tier) and map to slack_channel + pd_escalation_id. Fallback to oncall if no mapping.
Slack: use message blocks with action buttons that call Console APIs. Buttons should perform idempotent requests and be rate-limited.
PagerDuty: use Events API v2 to create incidents with dedupe_key = change_signature. Ensure incidents are auto-annotated with eval-run id and console link.
Observability: emit telemetry for alert_emit, alert_deduped, alert_ack, alert_resolution with tags for model_family, customer_id, and change_signature.
Privacy: do not include customer PII in sample prompts. Redact or truncate samples per redaction guidelines.
